biocontainers.name: bioframe
biocontainers.summary: Pandas utilities for tab-delimited and other genomic files

biotools.summary: Bioframe is a Python library designed to provide efficient operations on genomic interval dataframes. It extends the Python data science stack by building upon NumPy and Pandas, enabling flexible and performant data analysis in computational genome biology.
